{c_important}Human{/c} Skills' first hit Pull Close enemies towards the hit enemy and Immobilize them for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds. May only occur once every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.

{u}{c_important}Hindered{/c}{/u} enemies take {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage from your {c_important}Human{/c} Skills.
